blocks.text: The System Resource Groups page lists unmanaged system-level resource groups. You can use these view-only resource groups to define policies. To learn more, see Configuring Microsegmentation Policies.
The System Resource Groups page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a summary of resource group data.
Take appropriate actions based on the resource group data displayed.
Discover insights about collective resource group data.

blocks.heading: About the System Resource Groups Page

blocks.text: On the System Resource Groups page (Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Resource Groups > System), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
View a list of all resource groups. For each resource group, you can see:
Name: The name of the resource group.
Resource Type: The type of resource group (Unmanaged).
Member Count: The number of resources in the resource group.
Click an individual resource group to view its complete information.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the User-Defined Resource Groups page.
Go to the ML Recommendations for Resource Groups page.
